name: Kasak Malhotra
gpu_used: Colab T4 GPU for Task 5 NLI fine-tuning and scoring; local CPU for Tasks 1-4

task3.hybrid_method: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (BM25 + all-MiniLM-L6-v2); k=20 in t3_hybrid, k=15 candidate fusion for improved reranking

task5.retriever_used: Task 3 improved t3_rerank.trec; top-2 abstracts scored per claim
task5.nli_model: MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli fine-tuned on train claims (2 epochs, lr 1e-5, batch 16, seed 42) plus BM25-mined NEUTRAL pairs from train claims with no evidence; 1-2 sentence windows
task5.zero_shot_or_finetuned: fine-tuned on train claims only; rank-1 margin threshold 0.70, rank-2 abstract added only at margin >= 0.95, both selected on validation triple-F1
